title: Members
description: People with access to this project. Invite people by email; owners can revoke access.
lastOwner: A project must keep at least one owner
leaveDescription: You will lose access to this project and its issues. An owner can invite you back later.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Custom roles and the permissions each grants. Assign a role to a member from the Members list.
